title: 第16章 希望第17章 名誉
content_zh:
第016章 希望
评价一个人的强弱与否，最好的办法就是，看他的对手是谁！
毫无疑问，最终的比斗会在唐安和王锋之间展开。
这从比斗一开始分好组别的时候就已经注定了的。更准确的说，当三个月前王锋将唐安踢倒在地上，唐安不服气回身反击的瞬间，就已经注定了。
王锋，乃是蜀山七绝剑之一【赤金剑】王瑞图的二子。由于王锋出生后不久，王瑞图便被师傅召回，得知他的师傅要闭关修炼，试图突破天人第七重进入天人第八重，将会放下所有的世俗之事。而这蜀山剑派上的的一切事物，将由他来继承。于是，他便顺理成章的成为了蜀山位高权重的七大首座之一。
而王瑞图更是把这种从天而降的喜悦，完完整整的体现在了他这个小儿子身上！
要知道，他的师傅并不只有他一个弟子。而且武功品貌最好的，也绝不是他。王瑞图也从来都没有奢望过自己会继承蜀山【赤金剑】这个名号。那对他来说，确实就像是天上掉馅饼砸中了自己一样。当他知道这个消息的时候，更是幸福的都快昏过去了。
而在这个时候出生的王锋，更是被王瑞图当作了是老天为自己送来的宝，那真的是从小就集万千宠爱于一身，要风得分，要雨得雨，所有人都当菩萨一样供在家里，完全就是一个小祖宗。在这样的环境下成长出来的孩子，不想成为纨绔都很难！
幸好，那并不是一个一无是处的纨绔。
当王瑞图发现自己这个儿子居然天赋异禀，从小就经脉通顺，甚少有堵塞之处，就连小经脉都如此。修炼内气心法更是比一般人快了足足两倍。这让因为大儿子资质普通，久久不能进入内门而担忧不已的王瑞图，一下子找到了自己的继承人！
王家眼下虽然风光无限，可是自己迟早有一天便会和自己师傅一样，不得不面对冲击更高境界的诱惑。到了那时，王家的隐患便出来了。
作为一个江湖人，尤其是一个高手，没有事比修炼更高的境界带来的诱惑更大的东西了！所以，王瑞图很害怕，他怕自己一旦闭关之后，王家没有了一个足够分量可以支撑整个家族的人。
太上长老的名称虽然好听，可是根本就比不上蜀山首座的权势来的大。若有一天他自己闭关了，他能想象自己家人的待遇。就像他自己是蜀山首座，家人就可以仗势欺人，等他不是首座了，别人仗势欺人的对象说不定就是自己那几个儿女了。
那差距，就像是从天堂掉下了地狱，王瑞图想想都不能接受。于是，王锋很自然的承载了他所有的意志。他要让王锋来接自己的班，继续成为蜀山首座。
蜀山首座的承接，乃是由各脉的首座自定，只要报给掌门同意即刻，王瑞图的权利可大着呢。他若是不好好利用这个权利，他每天晚上睡觉都不会安心。
不过，他忽略了一点，他从来没有问过王锋愿不愿意！
在王瑞图想来，这么好的事情，打着灯笼都难找，有什么不愿意的？可是，他却不想想。做惯了大少爷的王锋，却突然要被逼得每天起来辛苦修炼，尤其是修炼各种招式，那更是累的腰酸背痛，和他原先的安逸生活想比，这就是地狱。
王锋恨自己老爹逼自己练功，为此，他甚至看到别人在辛苦修炼，心里就会极度不爽！那一天，他看到唐安举起了巨石后开心的模样，心底便没来由的一阵厌恶！
练功在他看来，就是一件极其讨厌的事！他不喜欢练功，当然也讨厌这种因为修炼带来的成果。在他知道唐安是为了成为内门弟子而拼命的修炼时，他的心头火气便更大！
内门弟子，内门弟子！这几年来，父亲在他耳边说的最多的就是这句话。每当他听到这句话时，他都会忍不住的全身发抖，心里气愤的想要毁掉眼前的一切！

包括自己！
为此，他更加讨厌眼前的这个，最后的对手——唐安！
王锋恶狠狠的看着唐安，说道：“废物永远都是废物！你以为苦练三个月，就能打败我吗？今天，我就让你后悔！你三个月来修炼的越勤奋，今天，我就让你越后悔！”他的语气恶毒非常，绝不像是在开玩笑。
那当然不是玩笑！
王锋的左手轻轻摸了摸藏在自己右手袖口里的东西。那里有一枚很小很小的银针，淬了毒，碧鳞蛇毒！一种只需要一点点就能让人内气全失的剧毒！
这种毒，对于天人五重境以下的人来说就是一个彻彻底底的噩梦。
它不会立马将人毒死。可是只需要碰到一点，中毒的人便会立马全身无力，昏厥过去，而在之后的半个时辰内，中毒人的内气就会一片混乱，慢慢被毒素所浸染，然后内气全部消散。最后中毒之人便再也修炼不了内气，成为一个彻彻底底的废物！
“半个时辰后，等他们发现的时候，你已经是废物了！”
王锋一想到唐安会用那种极度怨恨的眼神看着自己，可是却发现自己什么都做不了的绝望脸色时，他便兴奋的全身止不住的颤抖起来。看到别人绝望，那便是他唯一快乐的时候。因为，在他很小的时候，他的父亲便再也没有给过他希望。
“蜀山首座，那是他的希望，绝不是我的！”
王锋的表情在一刹那变得极为狰狞，他移动的速度极快，就在一眨眼的时间里就靠近了唐安。
他的拳头猛的向唐安的脸孔砸过来！
唐安早就知道王锋的速度极快，他的脚上顺势退后一步，不急不缓的让过王锋的一拳重击。
“他的速度虽然很快，可是我也不慢！这场比斗，我一定要赢！不赢，我进不了内门修炼更为高级的功法，我何时才能回家？”
唐安要回家，他要成为一个武林高手，然后风风光光的回家！再也没有人可以威胁到自己和自己的父母！那回家的希望，就是他的一切，挡在他面前的所有人，他都要统统扫掉！
“唰！”
唐安退后一步之后，左腿却猛然一个上踢，扫向王锋的下巴。
王锋的瞳孔一竖，身子止住，脖子向后一仰，险险避过。
“呼！”
劲风声掠过王锋的下巴，王锋的心脏更是不争气的跳动了几下。

唐安在左腿扫过后，接连右腿再上踢，扫向王锋。
王锋的双眸如毒蛇般盯着唐安的这一腿。
“就是这个时候！”
王锋那一直蓄势的右手突然出击，如同闪电一般，猛的一拍，直接拍击在唐安的脚面上。“蓬”的一声，唐安的右腿被硬拍下来，他不由的身形不稳。
“喝！”
王锋一声低喝，借势直接一个转身旋风踢。
“呼！”
他的左腿宛如大铡刀一样，急速扫向唐安的脖颈处。
唐安被他一拍，身子本就不稳，现在根本来不及后退。
不过他不慌不忙，整个人直接一个后仰躲过这一腿，右手一撑地，然后身子一矮，不仅没有后退，却是直接调整身体，一个扫堂腿攻击王锋的下盘。
王锋灵敏的一个后跃，躲过这一次攻击。可就在他后跃的一瞬间，唐安竟然出乎意料的猛然前扑，压向还没来得落地的王锋，他一接触到王锋的身体，那双拳就如同炮弹一样疯狂砸下。
“砰砰砰！”
唐安骑在王锋的腰间上，双拳死命的朝他的脸上轰去，众人只听到一阵骨头之间碰撞发出的脆响！
那是唐安的骨节和王锋的脸骨接触发出的。
唐安听到这清脆的声响，嘴角便不由得扯起一抹笑容。
“三月前你欠我的一顿揍，我今天就要彻彻底底的讨回来！”
王锋躺在地上满脸是血，眼睛通红，就像要凸出来一样，眼球上布满血丝，死死盯着唐安。他的喉咙间忽然发出一声野兽般的咆哮。紧接着，他的腰板一挺，双膝疯狂地顶向上面的唐安，强劲的大腿力量，硬是将唐安给顶飞了。
王锋抹了一把，手上居然满是鲜血，他大吼一声，“我要杀了你！”顿时，他的双腿如同幻影一般，接连踢向还未站稳的唐安。
“噗！”“噗！”“噗！”……
唐安用双手，接连挡住王锋的含怒两脚。

“杀！！”
王锋嘶吼一声，猛然前进，双腿疯狂扫踢，打得唐安在一瞬间接连后退。他的腿极为有力，速度也极快。
面对王锋暴风骤雨般的打击，唐安一时间只能暂避锋芒！
“不能再退了！”
底下忽然有人喊道.是那个小女孩！只见她一脸担忧的看着唐安，唐安的处境可不妙啊。
唐安一怔。原来，他已经退到边缘了，再退，就出了擂台了。
“受死吧！”
这时候，王锋一个飞跃，双腿不顾一切便朝唐安蹬踢过来。
而唐安，居然没有躲开！
他悬了！
“嘭！”
王锋的右腿重重的踢在唐安的胸口上，唐安顿时就感觉到胸口就像是被大锤子给砸了一下一样，心脏也猛地停顿了一下！他的喉头一甜，一口鲜血就顿时喷吐了出来。而他整个人也瞬间倒飞了出去。
场外围观的人原本脖子伸得长长的，可看到唐安被击中后，嘴里却叹息一声，心底紧蹦着的那一根线却是突然松了。
在他们看来，在王锋这一脚之后，胜负已分！
而两边的裁判看到这个情况也都摇摇头，就等着宣判王锋胜利了。外门弟子可没有能力在空中进行挪移！
可是，就在这时候，出乎所有人的意料！
“给我出来！”
唐安一声大吼，他的双手突然往前一伸，硬是拉住了王锋的右腿。他的身子猛地朝后仰去，手上用尽了全身所有的力气，将王锋朝后面猛的一甩。
顿时，那王锋整个人就被甩地抛飞起来，朝着擂台外面飞去！
这胜负情景，居然在最后发生一百八十度的转弯！

可就在这时，一点寒光，一点碧绿色的寒光，忽然在空中闪了一下。它是那么不起眼，所有人都没有看到它的存在！
那两个内门弟子此刻把所有的注意力都放在了两人的胜负之上，见胜负已分，心中提着的精神骤然一松，也根本没有看到这点寒光。
王锋算计好了一切！
就在这个所有人都松懈的瞬间，他袖口的那一枚碧鳞银针“唰”的就飞向了唐安！
唐安刚刚经历大战，赢得极为艰难，此刻见王锋被自己打飞，内门弟子资格已经确定，正是心头松懈之时。瞬间，他就感觉到自己的胸口疼了一下，之后更是一阵发闷，全身也立马感觉到了一阵无力。天地开始摇晃，他的眼前开始恍惚。人影开始隐隐幢幢，看不清楚。
擂台上不准使用武器，当然更不允许使用暗器。淬毒的暗器，那更是想都不要想了！他完全没有料到，王锋居然是如此的胆大包天
不过，唐安并不知道自己中毒了。他以为自己赢了，可以进入内门了，很快就可以学到武艺回家了，脸上也跟着浮起了笑容。
“我赢了……娘……我很快就会回家了……”
他说完，眼睛一闭，捂着胸口猛的栽倒在地，场面顿时一阵慌乱……
王锋躺在擂台外的地上，看着唐安倒地，他的眼神里全是疯狂。他知道这是自己亲手干的，他毁掉了眼前这个人的一切希望！
想到这里，他忽然神经质的哈哈大笑起来！
content_en:
Chapter 016 Hope
The best way to evaluate a person's strength is to see who his opponent is!
There is no doubt that the final battle will begin between Tang An and Wang Feng.
This was already determined from the beginning of the competition when the groups were divided. To be more precise, when Wang Feng kicked Tang An to the ground three months ago and Tang An was not convinced and turned around to fight back, it was already doomed.
Wang Feng is the second son of Wang Ruitu, one of the Seven Ultimate Swords of Shushan [Red Gold Sword]. Not long after Wang Feng was born, Wang Ruitu was recalled by his master and learned that his master was going to practice in seclusion, trying to break through the seventh level of heaven and man and enter the eighth level of heaven and man, and would put down all worldly things. And everything about the Shushan Sword Sect will be inherited by him. Therefore, he naturally became one of the seven most powerful leaders in Shushan.
And Wang Ruitu fully embodied this joy that fell from the sky in his little son!
You know, his master is not the only disciple. Moreover, he is definitely not the one with the best martial arts skills and appearance. Wang Ruitu never expected that he would inherit the title of Shushan [Red Gold Sword]. To him, it was indeed like a piece of cake falling from the sky. When he knew the news, he was so happy that he almost fainted.
And Wang Feng, who was born at this time, was regarded by Wang Ruitu as a treasure sent by God for him. He was really loved by thousands of people since he was a child. He was favored by the wind and rained by the rain. Everyone worshiped him at home like a Bodhisattva. He was completely like a little ancestor. It is difficult for children who grow up in such an environment not to become a naughty boy!
Fortunately, that's not a good-for-nothing dude.
When Wang Ruitu discovered that his son was actually gifted, his meridians had been smooth since he was a child, with very few blockages, even in the small meridians. Practicing the inner energy method is twice as fast as ordinary people. This made Wang Ruitu, who was worried because his eldest son had ordinary qualifications and could not enter the inner gate for a long time, suddenly found his heir!
Although the Wang family is enjoying great glory now, sooner or later, like his master, he will have to face the temptation of reaching a higher realm. At that time, the hidden danger of the Wang family emerged.
As a martial artist, especially a master, there is nothing greater than the temptation brought by cultivating to a higher realm! Therefore, Wang Ruitu was very scared. He was afraid that once he went into seclusion, the Wang family would not have anyone who could support the entire family.
Although the name of Taishang Elder sounds nice, it is not as powerful as the leader of Shushan Mountain. If one day he goes into seclusion, he can imagine the treatment of his family. Just like if he is the leader of Shushan, his family can use his power to bully others. When he is no longer the leader, his children may be the ones others bully.
The gap was like falling from heaven to hell. Wang Ruitu couldn't accept it even thinking about it. Therefore, Wang Feng naturally carried all his will. He wants Wang Feng to take over his class and continue to be the leader of Shushan.
The succession of the first seat of Shushan is determined by the first seat of each lineage. As long as the leader is reported to the leader for approval, Wang Ruitu has great power. If he doesn't make good use of this right, he won't be able to sleep at ease every night.
However, he overlooked one thing. He never asked Wang Feng if he was willing!
When Wang Ruitu thought about it, such a good thing was difficult to find even with a lantern, so why wouldn't he? However, he didn't want to think about it. Wang Feng, who was used to being an eldest young master, was suddenly forced to get up and practice hard every day, especially practicing various moves. It was even more exhausting and caused backache. Compared with his original comfortable life, this was hell.
Wang Feng hated his father for forcing him to practice martial arts. For this reason, he would even feel extremely unhappy when he saw others practicing hard! That day, he sawWhen Tang An looked happy after lifting the boulder, he felt a sense of disgust in his heart for no reason!
In his opinion, practicing is an extremely annoying thing! He doesn't like practicing martial arts, and of course he hates the results brought about by practicing. When he knew that Tang An was practicing desperately in order to become an inner disciple, he became even more angry!
Inner disciple, inner disciple! In the past few years, this is what his father has said most in his ears. Whenever he heard this sentence, he couldn't help but tremble all over, and he was so angry that he wanted to destroy everything in front of him!
Including myself!
For this reason, he hated the person in front of him even more, his final opponent—Tang An!
Wang Feng looked at Tang An fiercely and said: "Trash will always be trash! Do you think you can defeat me after practicing hard for three months? Today, I will make you regret it! The harder you practice in the past three months, the more I will make you regret it today!" His tone was very vicious, and it was definitely not a joke.
Of course that's no joke!
Wang Feng's left hand gently touched the thing hidden in the cuff of his right hand. There is a very, very small silver needle there, quenched with poison, green-scaled snake venom! A kind of poison that can make people lose all their inner energy with just a little bit!
This kind of poison is a complete nightmare for people below the fifth level of heaven and human realm.
It doesn't kill people immediately. But as long as it touches a little, the poisoned person will immediately become weak and faint, and within half an hour, the poisoned person's internal energy will be in chaos, slowly being infiltrated by the toxin, and then all the internal energy will dissipate. In the end, the poisoned person can no longer cultivate his inner energy and becomes a complete waste!
"When they find out half an hour later, you will be useless!"
When Wang Feng thought that Tang An would look at him with that kind of extremely resentful look, but when he found his expression of despair that he couldn't do anything, he became so excited that his whole body couldn't stop trembling. Seeing others in despair is the only time he is happy. Because, when he was very young, his father never gave him hope again.
"The first one in Shu Mountain is his hope, not mine!"
Wang Feng's expression became extremely ferocious in an instant. He moved extremely fast and was close to Tang An in the blink of an eye.
His fist slammed into Tang An's face!
Tang An had long known that Wang Feng was extremely fast. He took a step back with his feet and let Wang Feng's punch pass without any haste.
"Although he is very fast, I am not slow either! I must win this fight! If I don't win, I won't be able to enter the inner sect to practice more advanced techniques. When can I go home?"
Tang An wants to go home, he wants to become a martial arts master, and then go home in glory! No one can threaten yourself and your parents anymore! The hope of returning home is everything to him, and he will sweep away everyone who stands in front of him!
"Uh-huh!"
After Tang An took a step back, his left leg suddenly kicked up and swept towards Wang Feng's chin.
Wang Feng's pupils stood up, he stopped, tilted his neck back, and narrowly avoided it.
"Phew!"
The sound of strong wind passed over Wang Feng's chin, and Wang Feng's heart beat several times unsatisfactorily.
After Tang An swept his left leg, he kicked up his right leg again and swept towards Wang Feng.
Wang Feng's eyes stared at Tang An's leg like poisonous snakes.
"This is the time!"
Wang Feng's right hand, which had been gathering momentum, suddenly struck out, like lightning, with a fierce slap, directly hitting Tang An's feet. With a "peng" sound, Tang An's right leg was forcefully slapped down, and he couldn't help but feel unstable.
"Drink!"
Wang Feng shouted low and took advantage of the situation to turn around and kick with a whirlwind.
"Phew!"
His left leg was like a big guillotine, rapidly sweeping toward Tang An's neck.
Tang An's body was already unstable after being slapped by him, and now he had no time to retreat.
However, he took his time and continued toThe individual leaned back to avoid this kick, put his right hand on the ground, and then lowered his body. Not only did he not retreat, but he directly adjusted his body and attacked Wang Feng's lower body with a sweeping kick.
Wang Feng quickly jumped back and dodged the attack. But the moment he jumped back, Tang An unexpectedly lunged forward, pressing against Wang Feng who had not yet landed. As soon as he came into contact with Wang Feng's body, his fists were smashed down like cannonballs.
"Bang bang bang!"
Tang An rode on Wang Feng's waist and punched him in the face with both fists. Everyone only heard a crisp sound from the collision between bones!
It was caused by the contact between Tang An's joints and Wang Feng's facial bones.
When Tang An heard the crisp sound, he couldn't help but smile.
"The beating you owed me three months ago, I'm going to get it back today!"
Wang Feng was lying on the ground with his face covered in blood, his eyes red as if they were about to bulge out, and his eyeballs were covered with bloodshot eyes, staring at Tang An. A beast-like roar suddenly erupted from his throat. Immediately afterwards, he straightened his back and pushed his knees crazily towards Tang An, who was above him. The strong force of his thighs forced Tang An to fly away.
Wang Feng wiped it, and his hands were actually full of blood. He yelled, "I'm going to kill you!" Suddenly, his legs were like phantoms, kicking Tang An one after another, who had not yet stood firm.
"Poof!" "Poof!" "Poof!"...
Tang An used his hands to block Wang Feng's angry kicks one after another.
"Kill!!"
Wang Feng roared and advanced suddenly, kicking and sweeping his legs wildly, causing Tang An to retreat in an instant. His legs are extremely powerful and his speed is extremely fast.
Faced with Wang Feng's stormy attack, Tang An could only avoid the edge for a while!
"We can't retreat any further!"
Suddenly someone shouted from below: It's that little girl! She looked at Tang An with a worried look on her face. Tang An was in a bad situation.
Tang An was startled. It turned out that he had already retreated to the edge, and if he retreated again, he would be out of the ring.
"Suffer death!"
At this time, Wang Feng made a leap and kicked Tang An with his legs desperately.
And Tang An actually didn't avoid it!
He's hanging!
"Bang!"
